class.name: Superposition
class.brief_description: Inspector configured, server authoritative gameplay property replication.
class.description: Add this node under the gameplay target. Set [member session_path] to a configured EGPNet node, then select supported target properties using the Replicate checkboxes. The selections create [SuperpositionProperty] rules in [member config]. Matching server and client scenes share the configuration. An empty key uses the target's scene path; explicit keys must be unique for their entity kind in a session. States are quantized before change detection and transported using the native reliable entity lifecycle. Unchanged states do not generate updates. Late joining and interest re-entry receive the current baseline. This initial version is suitable for low rate gameplay values; high rate physical motion should use the independent unreliable snapshot stream with [EGPNetSnapshotInterpolator]. Property smoothing is cosmetic easing and does not implement physics prediction or rollback. Received envelopes are bounded to 4096 bytes and 32 typed properties, with objects disabled and whole schema validation before setters. Interest filtering is relevance optimization, not a confidentiality boundary: initial entity creation can precede observer filtering. Unspecified observers see the entity. Assign current observer positions explicitly; remove disconnected observers with [method clear_observer].

method.name: apply_state
method.description: Validates an envelope and applies the selected properties on a replica. Rejects calls when bound to a listening server. This method is not an input RPC.

method.name: capture_state
method.description: Produces a bounded quantized protocol envelope or an empty array on validation failure.

method.name: clear_observer
method.description: Removes the observer and restores unrestricted visibility when the peer is still connected.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns entity, captures, sent, dirty_skips, applied, rejected, last_error and state_bytes, push_skips and priority. Failures also emit [signal replication_error].

method.name: mark_dirty
method.description: Notifies pushed capture that selected gameplay properties changed. Calls coalesce until the configured update interval. New entities and changed schemas always capture a complete baseline.

method.name: replicate_now
method.description: Captures a server state or applies the client's latest native entity revision. Automatic processing calls this at the configured rate.

method.name: set_observer_position
method.description: Sets a finite observer position for spatial interest. At most 64 observers are stored.

method.name: set_session
method.description: Binds an already configured session. Retires a previously owned server entity before rebinding. Poll the session through your existing EGPNet node.

members.member: Reusable property schema and scheduling policy.
Native entity kind reserved by the game for this replication schema.
Stable server/client identity. Empty uses the target scene path. Duplicate explicit identities are rejected.
Configured EGPNet node exposing its native session.
Gameplay node whose selected properties replicate.

signal.name: replication_error
signal.description: Observable validation, authority, transport or interest error.

signal.name: state_applied
signal.description: Emitted after a complete valid received state has been accepted.
